title: Dev-b AutoISF / Can't calculate acceleration
symptom: After switching G6 transmitters, the 5-minute interval desynchronized and recalculated values appeared. AutoISF plugin seems to not like recalculated values and can't get a reliable acceleration; all acceleration numbers are at 0. It selected an aggressive ISF for the last 3 BGs that were over target.
cause: The thread discusses whether the problem is with recalculated data or gaps in data. The user (robertrub) argues it is with recalculated data, while ga-zelle says it is with gaps in data. No definitive root cause is established.
evidence_quote: There is a problem with the recalculated data and AutoISF.
